description: Searches open grants, prizes, fellowships and SBIR/STTR awards together with government contract notices, and returns one list. Private foundations are not included. Inputs: query (keywords), and optional filters for category, status, deadline window, date added, organization, source, minimum quality and procurement type; user_context (organization type and location) refines ranking. Returns a page of matching opportunities (15 by default) with funder, deadline, status, a short summary and the official notice link. Counts toward the search allowance.

category.description: Category name from the dataset's category list, for example Grant, Construction or Research.

compact.description: Whether results are compact (default: true). Compact results include id, title, organization, category, url, deadline, deadlineType, daysUntilDeadline, deadlineLabel, lastRoundClosedAt, status, qualityScore and snippet. false returns full details including eligibility, amounts and match explanations.

deadline_within_days.description: Only opportunities closing within N days

limit.description: Max results (default: 15, max: 100; values above 100 are treated as 100). The nextCursor of the response continues to the next page.

min_quality.description: Minimum record-completeness tier (default: medium). any removes this quality-tier filter; relevance, access and other filters still apply.

new_within_days.description: Older name for posted_within_days, kept for compatibility: only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). The response includes newSince (count and newest and oldest added times) and windowCoverage.

organization.description: Organization or funder name to match.

posted_within_days.description: Only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). Same as new_within_days; when both are set, this value applies. With no query, the page is sampled across sources, and windowCoverage reports how many sources were sampled and served, the order ("recency" or "relevance"), and whether a retrieval limit cut the window.

procurement_type.description: Industry type for SAM.gov contracts. professional_services = consulting, engineering, R&D (NAICS 54xxxx, excludes manufacturing/construction noise). it_services = software, IT systems (NAICS 5415xx). construction = building projects (NAICS 23xxxx). manufacturing = production (NAICS 31-33xxxx). The service presets leave out commodity notices such as "O-RING" or "VALVE".

since.description: Stateless alternative to posted_within_days/new_within_days: ISO 8601 instant. Only opportunities ingested at or after this instant. The newSince.newest of a previous response is a valid value, which gives a stateless watermark.

source.description: Source domain or dataSource to match (e.g., "grants.gov" or "tier0-sam.gov").

exclude_naics_prefixes.description: NAICS prefixes to exclude. ["31", "32", "33"] excludes manufacturing and ["23"] excludes construction, which removes commodity notices such as "O-RING" or "VALVE".

location.description: US state (two-letter code or name), or "nationwide".

location_strict.description: With a recognized location, requests geographic filtering; nationwide or unspecified records and explicitly broader fallbacks may remain, as geographyFilterOutcome and warnings report.

looking_for.description: What the person is looking for: "grants", "contracts" or "all" (default); it weights the ranking toward that type.

organization_type.description: Common natural-language phrasing (e.g. "501(c)(3) nonprofit") is also parsed; unparseable values are ignored with an explicit note in the response. A tribal government fits government and a tribal nonprofit fits nonprofit.

procurement_type.description: Same preset as the top-level procurement_type, accepted here too; the top-level value applies when both are set.

name: search_grants_and_procurement
title: Search Grants & Contracts (Combined)
